findings.finding: The note says Avvakum's spiritual father was 'John Neronov of St Basil's in Moscow'. That takes the 1924 translators' 'St. Basil's Minster' as fact, and two vendored sources say otherwise: Neronov was archpriest of the Kazan Cathedral in Moscow. A Documented note should not state a church the record contradicts. This came from round 1's required text, carried over from era 8.
findings.evidence: cic/texts/conybeare_russian-dissenters_1921.txt:2344-2345 'Ivan Neronov, Protopope of the Kazanski church'; cic/texts/subbotin_materialy-dlia-istorii-raskola-v1-dokumenty-rus_1874.txt:548 'О протопопе Казанского, в Москве, собора Иване' (OCR-normalized); the note's only support is avvakum_life...harrison-mirrlees1924.txt:2107-2108 'St. Basil's Minster, to John Neronov'. Avvakum's own lines 1873-1876 name him as a Moscow archpriest.
